description: This file defines the HolidayMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface to configure menu items for holiday-related screens within the OrangeHRM Leave module. It sets up the screen for viewing the holiday list.

classes.name: HolidayMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the holiday menu within the leave module, specifically overriding the screen to display the holiday list.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default screen to display the holiday list when configuring the menu for a given screen.
